title: Survey Themes and Sentiment Dashboard
description: Free-text survey answers grouped into themes and scored for tone -- revealing a pattern an average rating would bury.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI Agents for Registration, Scheduling, and Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a themed, sentiment-scored summary of survey responses, the learner examines it to identify which theme most needs the club's attention.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover a bar for the exact count; bar colour carries the sentiment score
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which theme needs attention first and what makes it different from the largest positive theme.
